prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 13 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: Sebastian's apartment, living room, Day, soft bright sunlight through the floor-to-ceiling window.
Image 1: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S3
Image 2: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S4
Image 3: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 9: the prop breakfast; use only structure, material, and color
Image 10: the prop blanket; use only structure, material, and color
Image 11: the prop the bag containing her wedding dress; use only structure, material, and color
Image 12: the prop two coins; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Axis runs between the charcoal couch and the round dining table; the camera stays on the front-wall bookshelves side, in front of both. Natalie stands at the round dining table, on its couch side, in the cornflower-blue wrap dress, setting out breakfast: two white plates and two white mugs. Her small nude handbag lies on the round dining table with the two coins beside it. The long white dress bag hangs over the back of one of the two dining chairs. Sebastian stands between the charcoal couch and the round coffee table, facing the dining table, folding the oatmeal-grey knitted blanket. Sebastian's phone lies face down on the round dining table. Natalie's cropped ivory jacket hangs on the wall hooks beside the front door on the left wall.
Panel 1: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the bookshelves side; couch on frame left, dining table on frame right. Sunlit living room. Natalie sets two plates of scrambled eggs, toast and strawberries on the round dining table. Sebastian, by the charcoal couch, shakes out the oatmeal-grey blanket and starts folding it.
Panel 2: Medium shot, slight push in on Sebastian, eye-level, from the bookshelves side. Sebastian folds the blanket in half against his chest and looks across toward the dining table with a lazy half-smile.
Panel 3: Medium shot, locked-off, eye-level, on Natalie at the dining table. Natalie sets a mug of black coffee beside a plate without looking up, her jaw set.
Panel 4: Close-up, locked-off, eye-level, on Sebastian's face and shoulders. Sebastian's smile widens slightly; he drops the folded blanket onto the couch cushions.
Panel 5: Medium shot, handheld, eye-level, following Natalie's hands. Natalie lifts the long white dress bag off the back of the dining chair and drapes it over her left arm.
Panel 6: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Natalie's shoulder toward Sebastian, eye-level. Natalie's shoulder and the dress bag fill the frame edge; Sebastian, beyond her by the couch, nods at the bag and raises an eyebrow.
Panel 7: Medium shot, reverse over-the-shoulder shot from behind Sebastian's shoulder toward Natalie, eye-level. Sebastian's shoulder at the frame edge; Natalie at the dining table smooths the dress bag on her arm, matter-of-fact.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off, eye-level, on Sebastian. Sebastian slides his hands into his chino pockets, relaxed and confident.
Panel 9: Medium shot, locked-off, eye-level, on Natalie at the dining table. Natalie gives a short disbelieving laugh, slings her handbag on her shoulder and picks up the two coins from the table.
Panel 10: Medium two-shot, tracking with Natalie from the dining table to the couch, eye-level, from the bookshelves side. Natalie walks to Sebastian and ends standing in front of the round coffee table facing him; she takes his hand, turns it palm up and drops the two coins into it.
Panel 11: Close-up insert, high angle, locked-off, on Sebastian's open palm. Two silver quarters lie in Sebastian's palm.
Panel 12: Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off, eye-level, on Natalie. Natalie tilts her head with a small teasing smile, the dress bag over her arm.
Panel 13: Close-up, clean single, slow push in, eye-level, on Sebastian's face and shoulders. Natalie is off screen. Sebastian looks down at the coins, a slow amused smile spreading, and closes his fingers around them.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
